From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Zenlytics — PoC plan & success criteria (post-demo recap)

Hi Oliver / Priya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — really appreciate the time. Per our conversation, attaching a first draft PoC plan for your review (Zenlytics_PoC_plan_v1.pdf) and our evaluation checklist (redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx). High-level recap and proposed next steps below.

POC objective
- Validate Redwood Inference reduces 90th pct latency for your 2k token summarization workload and matches current output quality on the 50-sample eval set.

Success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: 90th percentile <= 250ms for single-request baseline (on dev dataset)
- Cost: token cost per 1k tokens <= current baseline by >= 20% with quantization/batching config
- Quality: BLEU/ROUGE and manual spot-check with your scoring rubric — no more than 5% drop in key metrics on the 50-sample eval set
- Integration: SSO and sample dataset ingestion into our eval harness within week 1

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria, share sample dataset + access
- Week 1 (kickoff): infra setup, model selection, baseline runs
- Week 2: tuning (batching/quantization), evaluation runs, interim check
- Week 3: final evaluation, handoff docs + recommendations

Owners & asks
- Zenlytics: provide 50-sample eval set, test account, and SSO config (Priya?)
- Redwood: PoC lead (me) and eng lead (Marcus Lin) for infra/ops

Next steps
1) Please review the success criteria and change requests inline in the plan by EOD Friday.
2) Confirm sample dataset and SSO point of contact so Marcus can request access.
3) If OK, we’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tue 27 Jul — proposed 10am PT.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Marcus’ contact details and a shared drive link once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
